info.title: General information
info.description: Overview and requirements for the Sequencer utility.

information.title: Description
information.description: Brief overview of the Sequencer utility and its purpose.

actions.message: This entry is displayed for information only and cannot be edited.

information.default: The Sequencer utility is a lightweight cooperative scheduler designed for bare-metal applications that do not require a full real-time operating system. It provides a simple and efficient way to register, trigger, prioritize, and manage tasks while keeping software complexity, memory usage, and runtime overhead low.

recommendation.title: Mandatory requirements

actions.message: This entry is displayed for information only and cannot be edited.

recommendation.default: Configure the required number of tasks and priority levels, then assign a valid task ID and entry function name to each task.
recommendation.description: The following requirements must be met before initializing the Sequencer. These steps are mandatory to ensure proper operation.

priority.title: Priority levels
priority.description: Set the number of priority levels supported by the Sequencer (1-32).

task_nbr.title: Number of tasks
task_nbr.description: Set the number of tasks managed by the Sequencer (1-32).

tasks_configuration.title: Task definitions
tasks_configuration.description: Configure the task ID and entry function for each task.

task_name.title: Task ID

actions.message: Task ID must be 3 to 32 characters long, start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

task_name.description: Set the task identifier used for code generation. A macro named MX_TASK_<UPPERCASE_NAME> will be generated.

entry_function.title: Entry function

actions.message: Entry function name must be 3 to 32 characters long, start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

entry_function.description: Set the function name called when the task is scheduled. A weak function will be generated and can be overridden in the application.
